thread:
allison (CEO): tagging the finance/runway follow-ups from the all-hands here. Drop clarifying questions and we'll answer.

leo (Eng Manager): can we get the monthly net burn number + runway assuming current committed contracts only? need it for planning.

mike (CFO): current net burn ~ $5.6M/month. Runway ~ 15 months with existing credit facility and no hiring catch-up. We'll publish a slide with sensitivity cases later today.

leo (Eng Manager): sensitivity cases? like if we backfill hiring or accelerate Dedicated ramp?

dan (Finance Lead): exact — we'll include three scenarios: base (current plan), conservative (slower ARR, no hiring), and aggressive (accelerated Dedicated + backfills). Each will show months of runway and break-even ARR.

tara (Data Science): procurement Q: for external evals (third-party model benchmarks) do we need legal review? some vendors have odd IP terms.

dan (Finance Lead): yes, anything involving data sharing or model weights needs Legal. If it's strictly benchmarking on public data with no model transfer, Procurement + Finance review is enough. Err on the side of Legal if you're unsure.

mia (People Ops): hiring clarification: we will allow backfills for frontline support / customer success / security roles immediately. All other backfills evaluated case-by-case. Managers should file a role request in Greenhouse and tag priority + business impact.

leo (Eng Manager): about cost controls — any new guardrails on sandbox infra/projects? can teams spin up GPUs ad-hoc?

dan (Finance Lead): ad-hoc GPU spinup is allowed but must use our tagged billing projects and a cost alert. For >$5k projected monthly spend, use the spend-burst fast track. We'll also enable a 7-day pre-approval for experiments over $1k.

allison (CEO): next steps: Mike/Dan will post the slide deck and procurement cheat sheet in #announcements. Mia will update hiring policy in Confluence and notify managers. Deploy-bot will post the recording.

deploy-bot: Slides + recording: https://redwood.link/ah/1769481123

leo (Eng Manager): thanks — useful info. :thumbsup:

mike (CFO): will follow up with an FAQ doc in #announcements addressing common scenarios (market hires, contractor conversions, trial vendor purchases).
